senses.en: declare to be true or admit the existence or reality or truth of
senses.zh: 声明为真实或承认存在或现实或事实

examples.en: He admitted his errors
examples.zh: 他承认自己的错误

examples.en: She acknowledged that she might have forgotten
examples.zh: 她承认她可能忘记了

examples.en: The program committee acknowledged the submission of the authors of the paper
examples.zh: 方案委员会确认文件作者的提交

senses.en: express recognition of the presence or existence of, or acquaintance with
senses.zh: 明确承认存在、存在或熟悉

examples.en: He never acknowledges his colleagues when they run into him in the hallway
examples.zh: 他从不承认同事在走廊里碰到他

examples.en: She acknowledged his complement with a smile
examples.zh: 她笑着承认他的补足

examples.en: it is important to acknowledge the work of others in one's own writing
examples.zh: 承认他人的作品 以自己的写作很重要

senses.en: express obligation, thanks, or gratitude for
senses.zh: 表示对下列事项的义务、感谢或感激:

examples.en: We must acknowledge the kindness she showed towards us
examples.zh: 我们必须承认她对我们的好意

senses.en: accept as legally binding and valid
senses.zh: 承认具有法律约束力和有效性

examples.en: acknowledge the deed
examples.zh: 承认这桩契约

senses.en: accept (someone) to be what is claimed or accept his power and authority
senses.zh: 接受自己的权利或权力;

examples.en: The Crown Prince was acknowledged as the true heir to the throne
examples.zh: 皇太子被公认为王位的真正继承人

examples.en: We do not recognize your gods
examples.zh: 我们不认得你的神
